name: grimoire-companion
description: Save pages to your local Grimoire library.
author: Robert Goniszewski <robert@goniszewski.com>

scripts.package:safari: pnpm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-packager .output/safari-mv2 --project-location .output/safari --app-name 'Grimoire Companion' --bundle-identifier com.goniszewski.Grimoire-Companion --swift --macos-only --copy-resources --no-open --no-prompt --force && node scripts/set-safari-deployment-target.mjs
